dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal conjecture on tripartite off-diagonal Ramsey numbers
dossier_meta.statement_text: It may be the case that $r(H,K_{n,n,n}^{(3)})\leq 2^{O_{H}(n\log n)}$ for all $H$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that $r(H,K_{n,n,n}^{(3)})\leq 2^{O_H(n^2)}$ for all $H$, and using the methods of [5] one can show a stronger bound $2^{O_H(n^{2-\epsilon})}$ for some $\epsilon>0$ depending on $H$. They suspect the true bound is $2^{O_H(n\log n)}$, which would help explain why the threshold $2^{\Theta(n\log n)}$ is so prevalent and hard to surpass in constructions for $K_n^{(3)}$.
